ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida NTDS.dit dump via ntdsutil 'ifm' (CISA AA23-319A credential-access chain)
ucs.description: Hunts the textbook Rhysida domain-controller credential heist documented in CISA #StopRansomware advisory AA23-319A: ntdsutil.exe invoked with the 'ifm'/'create full' subcommand to copy NTDS.dit + SYSTEM hive offline before staging Mimikatz/secretsdump. This is a near-zero-FP TTP outside of planned DC backup jobs and is one of the most repeatable signatures in Rhysida intrusions across the British Library, Prospect Medical and Chilean Army cases.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe" AND (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*") AND NOT Processes.user="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process as command_line | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "ac i ntds", "activate instance ntds")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"                  // exclude scheduled DC backup machine context
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("wbengine.exe","backupexec.exe","vssvc.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, ReportId
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "ac i ntds", "activate instance ntds")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName !endswith "\\wbengine.exe" and ParentProcessName !endswith "\\vssvc.exe"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Rhysida NTDS.dit Extraction via ntdsutil IFM
id: 6d3d8a1c-7a4b-4f1c-8b2e-r1ysid4ntds01
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects ntdsutil.exe being invoked with the 'ifm' / 'create full' subcommand to extract
  NTDS.dit and SYSTEM hive, a credential-access TTP documented in CISA AA23-319A as a
  characteristic step in Rhysida ransomware intrusions on domain controllers.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-319a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' ifm'
      - 'create full'
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  filter_backup_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\wbengine.exe'
      - '\vssvc.exe'
      - '\backupexec.exe'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not (filter_machine_account or filter_backup_parent)
falsepositives:
  - Scheduled DC backup using ntdsutil IFM by tier-0 admins (rare; whitelist by host/account)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE OR *\\Ntdsutil.exe) @CommandLine:(*ifm* OR *IFM* OR *"create full"* OR *"ac i ntds"* OR *"activate instance ntds"*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(ifm|create full|ac i ntds|activate instance ntds)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/(wbengine|vssvc|backupexec)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count(as=hits))
| sort(hits, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: ntdsutil IFM is not a generic 'credential dumping' template — it's the specific subcommand Rhysida operators repeatedly call from cmd.exe after dropping in via Cisco VPN with valid creds (CISA AA23-319A, MS-ISAC advisory). Legitimate ntdsutil use on a DC is rare and scoped to known backup tooling, which we filter out via parent + machine-account predicates. The detection short-circuits Rhysida BEF
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida impact-stage: CriticalBreachDetected.pdf drop + .rhysida mass-rename burst
ucs.description: Catches Rhysida's distinctive impact-phase signature: the ransomware binary writes a 'CriticalBreachDetected.pdf' ransom note into every traversed directory and renames victim files with the '.rhysida' extension (AES-256 + RSA-4096 hybrid). This is the same note format and extension seen in every public Rhysida case from May 2023 onward — making the file-event burst a near-deterministic late-stage tripwire when EDR has missed earlier kill-chain steps.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count as file_count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime dc(Filesystem.file_path) as folder_count values(Filesystem.file_name) as sample_files from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="CriticalBreachDetected.pdf" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.rhysida" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.rhysida-encrypted") AND Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified","renamed") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path | where file_count >= 10 OR folder_count >= 3 | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let NoteName = "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf";
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileRenamed", "FileModified")
| where FileName =~ NoteName
      or FileName endswith ".rhysida"
      or FileName endswith ".rhysida-encrypted"
      or PreviousFileName endswith ".rhysida"
| summarize NoteDrops      = countif(FileName =~ NoteName),
            EncryptedFiles = countif(FileName endswith ".rhysida" or FileName endswith ".rhysida-encrypted"),
            DistinctFolders = dcount(FolderPath),
            SampleEncrypted = make_set_if(FileName, FileName endswith ".rhysida", 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
      by DeviceId, DeviceName,
         InitiatingProcessAccountName,
         InitiatingProcessFileName,
         InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
         InitiatingProcessSHA256
| where NoteDrops >= 1 or EncryptedFiles >= 10 or DistinctFolders >= 3
| order by FirstSeen asc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where TargetFileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"
      or TargetFileExtension =~ "rhysida"
      or TargetFileName endswith ".rhysida"
      or TargetFileName endswith ".rhysida-encrypted"
| summarize NoteDrops      = countif(TargetFileName =~ "CriticalBreachDetected.pdf"),
            EncryptedFiles = countif(TargetFileName endswith ".rhysida" or TargetFileName endswith ".rhysida-encrypted"),
            DistinctFolders = dcount(TargetFilePath),
            SampleEncrypted = make_set_if(TargetFileName, TargetFileName endswith ".rhysida", 5),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated)
    by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| where NoteDrops >= 1 or EncryptedFiles >= 10 or DistinctFolders >= 3
| order by FirstSeen asc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Rhysida Ransomware Note Drop or .rhysida Extension Write
id: 8f2b3e9d-4c1a-4d8f-9c2b-r1ysid41mpact
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects the file-system artifacts that characterise Rhysida ransomware impact: a
  'CriticalBreachDetected.pdf' ransom note written to disk OR any file written with
  the '.rhysida' / '.rhysida-encrypted' extension. Both have been consistent across
  every public Rhysida intrusion since May 2023 (Prospect Medical, British Library,
  Insomniac Games, Port of Seattle, Chilean Army).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-319a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_note:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\CriticalBreachDetected.pdf'
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.rhysida'
      - '.rhysida-encrypted'
  condition: selection_note or selection_ext
falsepositives:
  - Red-team / tabletop exercise replaying Rhysida IOCs (validate against engagement)
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\\CriticalBreachDetected.pdf OR *\\criticalbreachdetected.pdf OR *\\CRITICALBREACHDETECTED.PDF) OR @TargetFilename:(*.rhysida OR *.RHYSIDA OR *.rhysida-encrypted))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| regex("(?i)(\\\\CriticalBreachDetected\\.pdf$|\\.rhysida(-encrypted)?$)", field=TargetFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function={ count(as=writes) | min(_time, as=firstSeen) | max(_time, as=lastSeen) | count(field=TargetFileName, distinct=true, as=uniq_files) })
| writes >= 10 OR uniq_files >= 10
| sort(firstSeen, order=asc)
ucs.rationale: Both the 'CriticalBreachDetected.pdf' ransom-note filename and the '.rhysida' extension are Rhysida-specific strings — they do not collide with LockBit, BlackBasta, Akira, Royal or Play file artifacts.
